reviewStatus: All 1640 icons named; 90 labels updated through collaborative review and 1550 inferred labels pending broader review. Bolt subtypes remain provisional; no unresolved naming decisions.

conventions.color: Colour describes blade, head, bow body or shield trim; it does not assert material or rarity.
conventions.variants: Most designs have ten colour variants; untrimmed wooden shields have four wood tones per shape.
conventions.naming: Original Kenmi filename stem is preserved, followed by a descriptive suffix.
